Hi Alice / Rajiv — quick technical notes and step-by-step for the smoke test. I’ll be on the kickoff Wednesday.

Compatibility highlights (OpenAI-compatible flavor):
- Endpoint surface: Redwood exposes an OpenAI-compatible REST endpoint (same path patterns: /v1/chat/completions, /v1/embeddings) and supports the openai-python/openai-js SDKs with a drop-in URL/key swap.
- Auth: API key header 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' — same as OpenAI.
- Model mapping: we provide model aliases (e.g., redwood/gptx-1 => maps to underlying quantized variants). Some models may have slightly different tokenization; run the tokenizer step below.
- Streaming: streaming semantics are identical (chunked transfer). Note: chunk boundaries and chunk size may differ; do not rely on chunk counts. Use message-complete detection instead of N chunks.
- Function-calling: supported, but we recommend validating your function schema — minor differences in error codes for malformed schemas.

Recommended smoke tests (48h):
A) SDK swap test (low friction)
- Replace base URL and API key in your existing clients. Example curl:
  curl https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat/completions -H "Authorization: Bearer $RDW_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood/gptx-1","messages": [{"role":"user","content":"${SAMPLE_PROMPT}"}]}'
B) Tokenizer normalization
- Run token counts for the same prompt on OpenAI and Redwood models. Use the included tokenizer scripts (see sample_prompt_diffs.json). We normalize whitespace + unicode NFKC before tokenizing.
C) Prompt diffing and scoring
- Metrics: token-level diff %, semantic similarity (embedding cosine), and top-k text diffs. Aim: <= 3% token diff and semantic similarity > 0.95 for success.
D) Latency/throughput run
- 1-hour ramp to 5k req/day shape (we'll provide a traffic generator) then measure p50/p95 latency and GPU utilization. For Dedicated pilot, we can pin capacity to avoid noisy neighbors.

Known edge cases to watch for:
- Some sampling RNG seeds are not portable across runtimes — small text-level variance expected even with identical parameters.
- Temperature/Top-p matching usually behaves the same, but floating-point precision can alter rare tokens.
- Embedding model vector dimensionality is stable but check model alias mapping; we'll provide exact dims per alias.

Attachments: sample_prompt_diffs.json (includes example tokenizer script and prompt set), example_curl_snippets.txt

Let me know which two engineers at FinCo need access and I’ll provision API keys and a sandbox org.

—Dylan
